title: Kotlin beyond Android: server, multiplatform and scripting

videos.script: This course came in through the Android door, and the next one is Android. The language is wider than that door. {{targets}} One compiler, four back ends: the JVM, JavaScript, WebAssembly and native code, and the line between what the language gives everywhere and what each platform's library adds. {{server}} A web server on the JVM, written with Ktor, where every request handler is a suspending function and everything from the coroutine lessons applies as it is. {{json}} JSON in and out, and the requests that are refused, one by the code and one by the type. {{test}} The same server tested in memory, with no port and no network. {{shared}} One function compiled twice, to bytecode and to JavaScript, with expect and actual where the platforms differ. {{script}} A Kotlin script, run like a shell script. {{next}} And what the planner takes with it to Android.
